title: BorgWarner to Showcase Expanded Aftermarket Portfolio and Unified Customer Offering at Automechanika Frankfurt 2026
summary: Read and download our latest press releases.
body_markdown:
- One BorgWarner Aftermarket: broader access to products, services and support through a unified aftermarket organization
- BERU strengthened as BorgWarner's dedicated ignition and diesel cold-start specialist brand
- Expanded portfolio and OE expertise supporting a growing and increasingly diverse vehicle parc


BorgWarner will showcase its growing aftermarket portfolio and latest technology solutions at Automechanika Frankfurt 2026, taking place September 8-12. At Hall 3.0, Booth A11, the company will demonstrate how it is helping customers address the evolving needs of today's vehicle parc through broader coverage, OE-based expertise and a more connected aftermarket offering.


"The aftermarket continues to evolve as workshops and distributors support an increasingly diverse vehicle parc," said Noureddine Saidi, General Manager, BorgWarner Global Aftermarket. “At Automechanika, we will demonstrate how BorgWarner is bringing products, expertise and support together under one aftermarket organization, making it easier for customers to access a broader portfolio while benefiting from the quality, engineering experience and technical support associated with our brands."


A key focus at this year's event is BorgWarner's ongoing transformation focused on improving and simplifying the customer experience. The One BorgWarner Aftermarket initiative gives independent aftermarket customers access to an expanded range of BorgWarner technologies with improved customer support through a centralized aftermarket organization and distribution network.


At the same time, BorgWarner continues to expand its offerings across key repair categories, including boosting technologies, engine timing systems, transmission and drivetrain technologies, exhaust gas management, thermal management, ignition technologies and diesel cold-start technologies. More than 800 new products are being introduced during 2026, helping customers expand vehicle coverage and address evolving repair needs across today's vehicle parc. To further simplify parts identification, BorgWarner will also highlight its enhanced online catalog and digital product information tools.


Another highlight at this year's event is the continued development of BERU, which has been re-established as BorgWarner's dedicated ignition and diesel cold-start specialist brand. Following the full return of the BERU distribution rights to BorgWarner, actively securing complete ownership of the brand once again, BERU products will be exclusively offered through BorgWarner's aftermarket network. More than 235 new BERU products are planned for 2026, including significant additions to the spark plug and ignition wire set range.


Visitors to the BorgWarner booth will experience technologies ranging from turbochargers, exhaust gas management solutions, transmission products, thermal management and ignition systems. The display will also feature advanced electrification technologies, including the Integrated Drive Module, S-Winding Stator, Electric Torque Vectoring Disconnect and an 800V SiC inverter featuring BorgWarner's Viper power module. These exhibits illustrate the breadth of BorgWarner's engineering expertise and provide a glimpse into the technologies shaping the vehicles that workshops will service in the years ahead.
